name: dataset-desk v0.1.3
body: dataset-desk[models] now installs sentence-transformers[image]. Without it, a fresh install couldn't load EmbeddingGemma 2's processor (found by the studio's calibration run on 2026-10-20).
Install from PyPI: pip install dataset-desk, or pip install "dataset-desk[models]".

release.yml: publishing a GitHub release builds the wheel and sdist, checks them with twine check, and publishes to PyPI by trusted publishing from the pypi environment, with SLSA provenance. It never fires on a push.

No NumPy upper bound. The desk doesn't use numba. An environment that adds numba-cuda beside it needs numpy>=2.4,<2.5 until numba-cuda supports NumPy 2.5 (studio smoke rung on the RTX 5090, 2026-10-20).
